title: Development
description: Python and JavaScript projects with GitHub: Python with uv and Node with npm and TypeScript mounted in; PyPI, npm, GitHub and DuckDuckGo open, everything else closed.

de.title: Entwicklung
de.description: Python- und JavaScript-Projekte mit GitHub: Python mit uv und Node mit npm und TypeScript eingehängt; PyPI, npm, GitHub und DuckDuckGo offen, alles andere zu.

notes: Python (3.14 with pip and uv) and Node (with npm and TypeScript) come with the preset (--toolchain python --toolchain node): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add them (sandbox-ai toolchain add python, sandbox-ai toolchain add node: downloads, their signatures and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Their registries are the ones this preset opens.

Other languages: --toolchain go (or rust, jdk, dotnet, zig, cc) on the command line, or into the running sandbox: sandbox-ai toolchain attach RUN go; their registries are opened with them. The presets rust, go, jvm, dotnet, c-cpp and zig bring one each.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
